design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: dynamic array: allocate, fill, resize
lines: dyn = new[16](dyn);        // grow, keeping old values
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: new[n](src) reallocates and copies the first n old elements, so the array can grow without losing data.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: clocking block skews
lines: cb.data <= 8'hA5;          // driven 2 ns after the edge
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: Inputs are sampled just before the edge and outputs driven after it, so the testbench never races the design.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: fork variants and wait fork
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: join_any leaves the losers alive, so a testbench normally follows it with disable fork.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: assignment, shallow copy, deep copy
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: b = a copies only the handle; new a copies the fields, and only an overridden copy() duplicates the objects they point to.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: two constraint blocks solved together
lines: constraint c_len  { len inside {[1:8]}; data.size() == len; }
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: Both blocks are active at once and solved as one AND, so len can only be 2, 4, 6 or 8.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: randomize and check the return value
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: randomize() solves every active constraint and returns 0 only when no value of the random variables satisfies them.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: class holding a virtual interface
lines: virtual bus_if vif;            // handle, not an instance
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: The class holds a reference to an interface instance created in a module, which is how class objects reach real pins.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: request eventually granted
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: The property is sampled every clock tick and fails if gnt is still low four cycles after req.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: a burst sequence with repetition
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: ##1 delays by one cycle and [*1:8] matches one to eight consecutive data beats between sop and eop.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: covergroup with a cross
lines: cp_len:  coverpoint len { bins low = {[0:3]}; bins high = {[4:7]}; }
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: The cross creates one bin per mode and len-range pair, so four modes and two bins give eight bins in all.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: coverpoint bin forms
rows: the values 0 to 3 as one group
each value of the range separately
every value no other bin took
values 8 or 9 flag a test error
design-verification-using-system-verilog.note: The [] suffix splits a range into one bin per value, which is why a four-value range counts four times in the total.

design-verification-using-system-verilog.title: testbench hand-off for a write and read-back
